title: Pyrogen-free culture of Gram-positive bacteria: verification by hemocyte degranulation and Factor C assays
protocol: Prepare culture media using pyrogen-free water in depyrogenised containers that have been baked at 200°C for at least 4 hours.
Quantify LPS levels in the sterilized media using the PyroGene™ Endotoxin Diagnostic Kit.
Use the media only if the LPS level is negligible for Gram-positive bacterial culture.
Measure potential presence of LPS again after completing the Gram-positive bacterial culture using the PyroGene Kit.
Collect hemolymph from the horseshoe crab by partial bleeding through cardiac puncture under pyrogen-free conditions.
Incubate the culture with the collected hemolymph on a borosilicate glass slide at room temperature for 20 minutes.
Examine the morphological change of the hemocytes under light microscopy to assess their inability to cause degranulation of the horseshoe crab hemocytes.
Incubate the culture with the hemolymph in a borosilicate glass test tube at room temperature for 90 minutes.
Observe the dense button of hemocytes formed at the bottom of the test tube to verify the pyrogen-free Gram-positive culture.
Collect the supernatant from the upper part of the incubation mixture.
Centrifuge at 150 x g at room temperature for 10 min to remove residual hemocytes.
Collect the supernatant for Factor C activity assay.
Mix 10 μl of the supernatant with 90 μl fluorescent substrate from the PyroGene™ Endotoxin Diagnostic Kit.
Monitor the fluorescence emission at 440 nm upon excitation at 380 nm.
Add 10 μg/ml LPS to the supernatant from step 8 and incubate at room temperature for 10 min prior to the Factor C assay.
For the negative control, use pyrogen-free saline in place of bacteria.
